name: Hiwonder MaxArm (suction cup, wrist D435)
description: The lab's second arm: three bus servos (base yaw, upper arm, forearm) with a parallel linkage that keeps the tool level, a rotating suction nozzle and an Intel D435 fixed to the wrist platform. Primitive geometry generated by build_model.py from hardware/maxarm/kinematics.py (the board's link lengths), the measured table contact (tool length) and the measured hand-eye calibration (camera mount). Driven by hardware.maxarm.sim_maxarm.SimMaxArmAPI; it is not the room's controllable (xArm) robot.

suction.note: The suction cup on the nozzle. A weld carries the object, taken when the cup lip is within sim_maxarm.SEAL_GAP_MM of its top. j4 is the parallel linkage's wrist joint (driven to -(j2+j3) by SimMaxArmAPI, never by a plan) and j5 the nozzle; both are listed because every actuator on the robot must be named.

notes: Joint limits come from the generated model's jnt_range (vendor pulse limits, build_model.py); hardware.maxarm.kinematics is the gate for every target, as on the device. The model is a build product: python robots/maxarm/build_model.py regenerates it, and hardware.maxarm.test_sim_maxarm fails when the file is stale.
